data.narrative:
Reveal Technology is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $30M+. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—including same-stage peers Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $30M total raised as a proxy base value, applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage advancement, yielding $60M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects meaningful variation in investor appetite and perceived risk within early-stage defense tech.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $230M across both methods. The $230M midpoint reflects material discounting of the peer-median outlier (Stark Defence at $4.0B) while remaining substantially above the stage-progression floor. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Reveal's technology differentiation, customer traction, and management team quality map to the upper or lower quartile of the peer set, and whether the extreme valuation variance observed among comparables reflects genuine performance divergence or market timing effects.
